name: task-manager
description: Full-stack task manager: a React client served by an Express + MongoDB API

scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client && npm ci --prefix server --include=dev && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
